rgb_mvtec_multiclass.description: Unimodal RGB multi-class anomaly detection and localization on MVTec-AD (15 categories, one model for all, normal-only training). Paper reference: AnomalDF with and without UCF, Table I (image/pixel AUROC, class-wise means) and Table XXIV (all seven metrics, 256px, N=3 templates). The gym runs the same dataset at 224x224 with a frozen DINOv2 ViT-S/14 and scores a hidden half of the official test set (880 images) whose defect types are disjoint from the visible development half; every metric is computed per category and averaged over the 15 categories, as in the paper.
rgb_mvtec_multiclass._scale_note: Scaled setup: 224px inputs (16x16 patch grid) instead of 256px, DINOv2 ViT-S/14, N=3 random same-category templates per input, a compact 3D U-Net filter (about 4M parameters instead of +43.8M), and the hidden half of the MVTec-AD test set (880 of 1725 images). The paper's numbers below come from its full-resolution AnomalDF setting on the whole test set; they are kept as the paper reported them and are not expected to be matched at this scale.

_paper_overhead.note: Table XII efficiency of AnomalDF+UCF. Self-reported cost numbers are not scored: the evaluator cannot recompute them from raw outputs.

rgb_mvtec_multiclass._paper_table_iv_metrics: The paper reports I-AUROC, I-AP, I-F1max, P-AUROC, P-AP, P-F1max and P-AUPRO for its RGB baselines (Table IV); AnomalDF+UCF itself is reported with I-/P-AUROC (Table I).

image_auroc.description: Image-level AUROC (%) of the per-image anomaly score: anomalous images ranked above normal ones.

pixel_auroc.description: Pixel-level AUROC (%) of the 224x224 anomaly maps over all pixels of the scored images.

pixel_aupro.description: Area under the per-region-overlap curve up to 30% pixel false-positive rate (%), normalised; every connected defect region counts equally, so small defects matter.

pixel_ap.description: Pixel-level average precision (%) of the anomaly maps; sensitive to false positives because defect pixels are rare.

image_ap.description: Image-level average precision (%) of the per-image anomaly score.

pixel_f1_max.description: Best pixel-level F1 (%) over all thresholds of the anomaly maps.

image_f1_max.description: Best image-level F1 (%) over all thresholds of the image score.

rgb_mvtec_multiclass._protocol: Class-wise mean: each metric is computed over one category's images and averaged over categories with equal weight (paper Tables I, IV, XXIV). A run whose class-mean image AUROC or pixel AUROC is below 70 is scored as failed (0 on every metric).

_paper_table_xxiv.note: Table XXIV, MVTec-AD, resize 256, N=3 templates (Exp. IDs 1-2); the same setting as Table I's AnomalDF columns.

rgb_mvtec_multiclass._coefficient_note: Image and pixel AUROC carry the most weight because the paper's main tables report them; AUPRO, pixel AP and the F1 metrics are the paper's additional metrics, where it reports its largest gains (Sec. IV-A3, Fig. 8).
rgb_mvtec_multiclass._template_budget: The paper's claim is accuracy with only N=3 normal templates per input, without a full memory bank. The evaluator cannot verify a method's memory, so the budget is a stated constraint (scoring/CONSTRAINTS.md), not a scored metric.
